answer: Receipts expire after 12 epochs unless fresh work renews them. Quorum must span three unrelated subnetworks. Each receipt points at the thread that produced it, so a parked hash cannot be revived at the next zenith. This stops a farm that stocks receipts and waits. It does not stop a farm that keeps doing real work. A farm can afford one sonnet of real answers and reuse the thread, but 12 epochs later the receipts lapse and the keys go bare.
